在严重依赖取暖用油保持家庭温暖的地区
在9700多人中，大约85%的人在被要求评价自己的饮食质量时偏离了实际情况
W: 不用线上支付了？哦
W: 哦，冲动消费对我来说也是个问题
W: 那你现在怎么办呢？感觉你用现金也会有同样的问题啊
M: 我每周去一次银行
W: 但如果你想买东西
M: 第一个月我确实又取了两次额外的现金

items.stem: Why are families across the U.S. looking to this winter with fear?

choices.text: They will see a 27% higher price to buy natural gas.
choices.zh: 他们购买天然气的价格将上涨27%。

choices.text: They will have insufficient heating oil to keep warm.
choices.zh: 他们将没有足够的取暖用油来保暖。

choices.text: They will have a costly bill to pay to heat their homes.
choices.zh: 他们将支付高昂的账单来为家里供暖。

choices.text: They will experience the coldest winter in four decades.
choices.zh: 他们将经历四十年来最冷的冬天。

items.stem: What did the federal government do last month?

choices.text: Provided additional funding to Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program.
choices.zh: 为低收入家庭能源援助计划提供了额外资金。

choices.text: Assured U.S. citizens of an increase in energy supplies by the end of this year.
choices.zh: 向美国公民保证今年年底前能源供应将增加。

choices.text: Predicted a 10% jump in heating bills for most U.S. households this winter.
choices.zh: 预测今冬大多数美国家庭的取暖费用将上涨10%。

choices.text: Decided on this year's energy assistance package of $8 billion in total.
choices.zh: 决定今年总额为80亿美元的能源援助方案。

items.stem: What is the main finding of a new study about many Americans?

choices.text: They care less about their diet now than before.
choices.zh: 他们现在对饮食的关注程度不如以前。

choices.text: They may lack adequate knowledge of healthy food.
choices.zh: 他们可能缺乏关于健康食品的充分知识。

choices.text: They may hold too optimistic a view about their diet.
choices.zh: 他们可能对自己的饮食持过于乐观的看法。

choices.text: They pay insufficient attention to their choice of food.
choices.zh: 他们对食物选择的关注不足。

items.stem: Who tended to rate their diet more accurately in the survey?

choices.text: Those who finished 24-hour food questionnaires.
choices.zh: 那些完成了24小时食物问卷的人。

choices.text: Those who fully understood the rating scale.
choices.zh: 那些完全理解评分量表的人。

choices.text: Those who cared about food quality.
choices.zh: 那些关心食品质量的人。

choices.text: Those who rated their diet as poor.
choices.zh: 那些将自己的饮食评为较差的人。

items.stem: What does the report say dozens of Indians did last week?

choices.text: They experienced a heartbreaking moment.
choices.zh: 他们经历了一个令人心碎的时刻。

choices.text: They gathered together to rescue an elephant.
choices.zh: 他们聚集在一起营救一头大象。

choices.text: They heard a noise from the bottom of a well.
choices.zh: 他们听到井底传来噪音。

choices.text: They found an elephant wandering around a well.
choices.zh: 他们发现一头大象在井边徘徊。

items.stem: Why did the army officers call the local forest department?

choices.text: To borrow their crane.
choices.zh: 借用他们的起重机。

choices.text: To ask them for help.
choices.zh: 向他们寻求帮助。

choices.text: To report the strange noise.
choices.zh: 报告奇怪的噪音。

choices.text: To get food for the elephant.
choices.zh: 为大象获取食物。

items.stem: What does the news report say happened finally?

choices.text: The elephant was able to return to the jungle.
choices.zh: 大象能够返回丛林。

choices.text: The army officers were examined for injuries.
choices.zh: 军官们接受了伤情检查。

choices.text: The army officers were rewarded for their rescue efforts.
choices.zh: 军官们因救援努力获得了奖励。

choices.text: The elephant was given medical treatment for many days.
choices.zh: 大象接受了多日的医疗治疗。

items.stem: Why has the man stopped paying online for the last three months?

choices.text: He found it had caused him much inconvenience.
choices.zh: 他发现这给他造成了很多不便。

choices.text: It led him to spend more money than necessary.
choices.zh: 这导致他花费了超出必要的钱。

choices.text: It was much less secure than paying with cash.
choices.zh: 这比用现金支付安全性差得多。

choices.text: He wanted to be less dependent on his phone.
choices.zh: 他想减少对手机的依赖。

items.stem: What problem does the woman say she may also have?

choices.text: Living beyond her means.
choices.zh: 入不敷出。

choices.text: Lack of budgeting strategies.
choices.zh: 缺乏预算策略。

choices.text: Fashion addiction.
choices.zh: 时尚成瘾。

choices.text: Impulse purchasing.
choices.zh: 冲动购物。

items.stem: What does the man say he could do at the canteen?

choices.text: Eat healthier food with less money.
choices.zh: 用更少的钱吃更健康的食物。

choices.text: Order food like burgers and chips.
choices.zh: 点汉堡和薯条之类的食物。

choices.text: Avoid getting addicted to junk food
choices.zh: 避免对垃圾食品上瘾。

choices.text: Pay either in cash or with his phone.
choices.zh: 用现金或手机支付。

items.stem: What is now just a habit for the man?

choices.text: Making a shopping list.
choices.zh: 列购物清单。

choices.text: Sticking to his budget.
choices.zh: 坚持他的预算。

choices.text: Withdrawing cash only once a month.
choices.zh: 每月只取一次现金。

choices.text: Thinking twice before buying something.
choices.zh: 买东西前三思而后行。

items.stem: Why is the woman opposed to their son joining a sport like soccer?

choices.text: He does not enjoy any ball games.
choices.zh: 他不喜欢任何球类运动。

choices.text: He has to prepare for the future.
choices.zh: 他必须为未来做准备。

choices.text: He has breathing problems.
choices.zh: 他有呼吸问题。

choices.text: He is not up to anything challenging.
choices.zh: 他无法胜任任何有挑战性的事情。

items.stem: What does the man suggest their son try in order to understand team spirit?

choices.text: Soccer.
choices.zh: 足球。

choices.text: Badminton.
choices.zh: 羽毛球。

choices.text: Volleyball.
choices.zh: 排球。

choices.text: Basketball.
choices.zh: 篮球。

items.stem: What is one of the woman's considerations in choosing a sport for her son?

choices.text: The possibilities of joining the school sports team.
choices.zh: 加入学校运动队的可能性。

choices.text: The opportunities of winning some championships.
choices.zh: 赢得一些冠军的机会。

choices.text: The chances of getting an athletic scholarship later on.
choices.zh: 日后获得体育奖学金的机会。

choices.text: The odds of becoming a professional sportsman someday.
choices.zh: 有朝一日成为职业运动员的可能性。

items.stem: What does the man say about beach volleyball?

choices.text: It differs entirely from indoor volleyball.
choices.zh: 它与室内排球完全不同。

choices.text: It appeals to both schoolgirls and schoolboys.
choices.zh: 它对女学生和男学生都有吸引力。

choices.text: It is less popular than indoor sports in the country.
choices.zh: 它在这个国家不如室内运动受欢迎。

choices.text: It is completely different from other outdoor games.
choices.zh: 它与其他户外运动完全不同。

items.stem: What do we learn from the passage about the lift-off of spacecraft?

choices.text: It usually requires years of preparations.
choices.zh: 它通常需要数年的准备。

choices.text: It does a lot of harm to the environment.
choices.zh: 它对环境造成很大危害。

choices.text: It often burns over three hundred tonnes of refined fuel.
choices.zh: 它通常燃烧超过三百吨精炼燃料。

choices.text: It proves to be the most complicated stage of space missions.
choices.zh: 它被证明是太空任务中最复杂的阶段。

items.stem: What happens traditionally to boosters, fuel tanks and other components in spaceflight?

choices.text: They are burnt up in outer space.
choices.zh: 它们在外太空被烧毁。

choices.text: They are guided back to Earth.
choices.zh: 它们被引导返回地球。

choices.text: They are reused up to 100 times.
choices.zh: 它们被重复使用多达100次。

choices.text: They are treated as expendable.
choices.zh: 它们被视为一次性消耗品。

items.stem: What does the passage say we already have regarding spaceflight?

choices.text: New technologies for bringing back space vehicles for recycling.
choices.zh: 将太空飞行器带回以供回收利用的新技术。

choices.text: The technology for meeting the needs of commercial space travel.
choices.zh: 满足商业太空旅行需求的技术。

choices.text: Many of the technologies to limit the impact of space travel on Earth.
choices.zh: 限制太空旅行对地球影响的许多技术。

choices.text: The technology for effectively protecting ozone from being destroyed.
choices.zh: 有效保护臭氧层免遭破坏的技术。

items.stem: What does research show about reading to a loyal and nonjudgmental companion?

choices.text: It can help unskilled readers feel more secure.
choices.zh: 它可以帮助阅读能力不足的读者感到更安心。

choices.text: It can encourage reluctant readers to read aloud.
choices.zh: 它可以鼓励不愿意阅读的读者大声朗读。

choices.text: It can strengthen children's confidence in others.
choices.zh: 它可以增强儿童对他人的信心。

choices.text: It can boost children's interest in communication.
choices.zh: 它可以提高儿童对交流的兴趣。

items.stem: How can parents make pets a fantastic subject for their children's research and learning?

choices.text: By motivating children to find out about their favourite pets.
choices.zh: 通过激励孩子去了解他们喜爱的宠物。

choices.text: By taking children to the library to borrow books on animals.
choices.zh: 通过带孩子去图书馆借阅有关动物的书籍。

choices.text: By allowing children to surf the internet about pets by themselves.
choices.zh: 通过允许孩子自己上网查询有关宠物的信息。

choices.text: By showing children how to acquire knowledge about healthy pets.
choices.zh: 通过向孩子展示如何获取有关健康宠物的知识。

items.stem: How can children still benefit even when their family doesn't have a pet?

choices.text: By learning that raising pets can do much good.
choices.zh: 通过了解饲养宠物可以带来很多好处。

choices.text: By watching how healthy pets are brought up.
choices.zh: 通过观察健康的宠物是如何被养育的。

choices.text: By hearing about their peers' passion for pets.
choices.zh: 通过听说同龄人对宠物的热情。

choices.text: By visiting friends who have household pets.
choices.zh: 通过拜访有家养宠物的朋友。

items.stem: What would the new bill in the Ohio legislature require public colleges and universities to do?

choices.text: Send would-be students a packet of information.
choices.zh: 向准学生发送一份信息资料包。

choices.text: Update regularly all information on their websites.
choices.zh: 定期更新其网站上的所有信息。

choices.text: Inform prospective students of their yearly enrollment.
choices.zh: 告知未来学生其年度招生人数。

choices.text: Answer questions raised by applicants and their parents.
choices.zh: 回答申请者及其家长提出的问题。

items.stem: What can the state only do according to Adam Mathews?

choices.text: Oversee private institutions directly.
choices.zh: 直接监管私立院校。

choices.text: Follow other states' example.
choices.zh: 效仿其他州的做法。

choices.text: Supervise all schools consistently.
choices.zh: 一致地监督所有学校。

choices.text: Regulate public institutions by law.
choices.zh: 依法监管公立院校。

items.stem: What do we learn about Ohio's schools from the passage?

choices.text: They are resourceful.
choices.zh: 它们富有资源。

choices.text: They are competitive.
choices.zh: 它们竞争激烈。

choices.text: They provide the best opportunity to realize one's dream.
choices.zh: 它们提供实现梦想的最佳机会。

choices.text: They appeal most to students from other states in the U.S.
choices.zh: 它们对来自美国其他州的学生最具吸引力。

items.stem: What is the problem with schools providing information on their websites?

choices.text: Some students waste much time surfing the net.
choices.zh: 一些学生在网上浏览浪费大量时间。

choices.text: Students may need to visit too many websites.
choices.zh: 学生可能需要访问过多网站。

choices.text: Students have to search for the information.
choices.zh: 学生必须搜索相关信息。

choices.text: Some students may lack adequate access.
choices.zh: 一些学生可能缺乏足够的访问途径。
